name: Cohesive Feed Grid
summary: A profile planned as one board: a 3-column grid of square photos with one preset, one palette and a fixed rhythm of image types. The viewer reads the whole grid before one photo.

philosophy.core_thesis: The grid is the product: each photo serves the profile page, so tone, colour and spacing repeat until the feed reads as one brand.
design_principles: Lay photos in 3 columns with 2px gaps, each a 1:1 square of 1080px.
Apply one preset to every photo, so that the average hue stays within 15° across the feed.
Limit the palette to 3 colours and repeat each in at least 1 of every 3 photos.
Alternate image types in a fixed rhythm: portrait, detail, text tile, in rows of 3.
Build text tiles on a flat colour from the palette with a centred quote at 48px to 64px.
Keep the profile header plain: a 77px round avatar, a 14px bio and a row of 5 highlight circles of 64px.
Plan 9 posts ahead in a scheduling app and check the grid before each post.
anti_patterns: Heavy filters that change each week
Collage tiles with 4 or more colours
Different crop ratios in one grid

layout.grid_mechanics: A strict 3-column grid of squares with 2px gaps; highlight circles in one row of 5 above it.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 15% stays empty; the spacing scale is 2, 8, 16 and 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: All squares align to the grid; the avatar and the name align flush left; the bio sits in one column of 300px.
layout.container_geometry: Squares with a 0px radius; round avatar and highlight covers; a 1px #DBDBDB line below the header.

font_pairings.note: A geometric sans for text tiles and a calm text face.
A serif for quote tiles in a soft, editorial feed.
A round, friendly sans for a bright brand feed.

typography.tracking: Display takes +0.04em; labels take +0.1em in capitals.
hierarchy_rules: Use one display face for all text tiles.
Keep text tiles to 12 words or fewer.

color.palette_structure: A neutral white page with one signature tan, one teal and one blush that repeat across the photos.
color.contrast_rules: Text on white holds at least 15:1; the three tones carry photo tints and text tiles, and white text on a tile holds 4.5:1 or more.
color.surface_treatment: Flat white chrome; tiles use flat palette colour; photos share one preset.
color.light_and_shadow: Even, soft light in all photos; no cast shadow in the chrome.

materiality.surface_simulation: A printed contact sheet or a mood board of equal squares.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px #DBDBDB line under the header; gaps of 2px between squares, with no border.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons at 24px with a 1.5px stroke: grid, reel, tag and heart.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Flat colour text tiles with one quote; no other drawn art.

motion.transition_physics: A tapped square opens at 250ms with a 4% scale; the grid does not move; highlights slide at 300ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover dims the square to 85% and shows a count of likes; tap opens the post in 250ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels trust and order, as if a brand with taste owns the page.

avoid_when: The content is raw news or live events.
The audience wants a candid, casual voice.
The team cannot keep one preset and one rhythm.

modifiers.how: Allow mixed crops, flash and blur and drop the fixed rhythm.
Replace staged photos with a front and back snapshot and a time stamp.
Use overhead still life frames on a pale surface.

pack.why: A clean linear family that fits a plain profile header and grid tabs.

ground.why: The ground is the tile grid: equal squares with thin gaps, as on a profile page.
